# noses — Osmograph Vial authoring CLI

> Author, validate, test and publish Osmograph Vials. One `vial.toml` manifest, three
> tiers (recipe | wasm | sidecar). Target time-to-first-working-Vial: under 60 seconds.

## Commands
- `noses create <name> [--template recipe|wasm]` — scaffold a working Vial (offline).
- `noses test [path]` — run fixtures against `recipe.json`; no hardware needed.
- `noses lint [path]` / `noses validate [path]` — schema, permission and licence checks.
- `noses dev [path]` — load and hot-reload in Osmograph Desktop.
- `noses publish [path]` — validate, then OIDC trusted publish (signed artifact).

## Rules an agent must satisfy
- `claims.evidence` is required whenever `claims.provides` is non-empty.
- Paid Vials must set `pricing.sealed = true`.
- `capabilities.network` entries must be exact hostnames (no wildcards).
- `vial.id` is reverse-DNS; `vial.version` is semver.

## Recipe ops
mean · min · max · range · first · last · std · delta(a - b)
